name: LeaseKey::from_path

test_list.description: Existing paths resolve before key construction; a missing leaf is admitted only under an existing canonical contained parent.
Escaping paths, lexical parent traversal, device/ADS forms and 8.3-like aliases never acquire independent keys.

inputs.name: root,path
inputs.description: Trusted workspace root plus requested relative or absolute path.

output_description: Canonical contained path identity without following an escaping alias.
